Game Overview

In Haunted Bricks, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a chilling world in Haunted Bricks, where breaking blocks uncovers spooky surprises. Bounce your way through eerie levels, avoiding ghostly traps and exploiting mysterious powers. As you survive the spectral challenges, experience an escalating thrill of speed and spine-tingling atmosphere in this hauntingly fun brick-breaking adventure.
